patch_description:
The current ansatz uses only 8 trainable keys per block and relies on two CZ ladders plus mirrored RY/RZ layers, which gives limited expressivity for the fixed ZZ feature map.  
This rewrite keeps the same training loop and measurement pipeline, but changes the block to a more balanced 12-parameter design: mirrored RY pre-rotations, long-range CZ mixing, mixed-axis controlled rotations (CRX/CRY/CRZ), mirrored RZ phase refinement, and a final local CNOT mixer.  
The key idea is to preserve parameter sharing across mirrored qubits while adding a small controlled-rotation core that can capture higher-order feature correlations faster and with less overfitting pressure than the previous purely CZ-based pattern.
